# Euro Prestige Imports (concept by Kerblabs)

> European car sales, brokerage, consignment, service and storage in Charlotte, NC. Facts from epicharlotte.com. This page is a free concept, not the company's own site.

## Facts
- Address: 8350 Arrowridge Boulevard, Charlotte, NC 28273.
- Phone: 704-305-5373 (site also lists 704-621-0752).
- Hours listed: Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm, weekends by appointment.
- Marques sold: Aston Martin, Ferrari, Porsche, Maserati, Land Rover.

## Services
- Sales, brokerage and consignment of pre-owned European cars
- Service and maintenance
- Collection maintenance
- Car storage (through Unknown Charlotte)
- TECHART Porsche parts (installer and dealer), urban styling kits

## Actions
- Contact: https://www.epicharlotte.com/ (contact form)
